tasks.title: Validate a small model configuration
tasks.prompt: Implement load_models(path) in config_reader.py. Read JSON with a top-level models object. Each model needs a nonempty provider. MLX models need a local path; openai_compatible models need a base_url and model. Raise ValueError for malformed data and preserve the mapping returned to callers. Do not add dependencies or alter the public signature.

tasks.title: Summarize scored evaluation records
tasks.prompt: Implement summarize(records) in summary.py. Return a dict with total, scored, successful and average_score. A score of None is unscored; only scores 0, 1, 2 are valid. Reject invalid scores with ValueError. Empty scored sets have average_score None. Do not mutate records.

tasks.title: Prevent cross-user report cache leakage
tasks.prompt: Fix report_cache.py so cache entries include user identity as well as filters. Filters can be provided in any insertion order and contain scalar JSON values. Preserve get_report(user_id, filters, build) and avoid extra builds for equivalent requests.

tasks.title: Correct retry exhaustion behavior
tasks.prompt: Fix retry.py. Keep call_with_retry(request, sleep, attempts=3). Retry TimeoutError only; sleep with delays 1, 2, ... only before another attempt. Reraise the last timeout, and reject attempts less than 1 with ValueError. Preserve other exceptions.

tasks.title: Add boundary tests for manual scoring
tasks.prompt: Add unittest tests in tests/test_scores.py for score_label in scoring.py. Cover all valid scores 0, 1, 2, invalid negative and high scores, noninteger values, and confirm the input is not coerced. Do not change scoring.py.

tasks.title: Prevent stale search responses
tasks.prompt: Fix search.js so createSearch(fetcher) exposes async search(query) and only the newest request may update its results. Abort the previous request when a new one begins. A rejected or aborted request must not produce an unhandled rejection. Keep the public API and do not add dependencies.

tasks.title: Normalize unique names
tasks.prompt: Implement Names.uniqueNames(List<String>) in Names.java. Ignore null and blank entries, trim names, deduplicate case-insensitively with Locale.ROOT, preserve the first trimmed spelling and input order, and return a new list. Do not mutate the input.

tasks.title: Validate keys at the API boundary
tasks.source: sanitized API and storage boundary pattern
tasks.prompt: Change api.py and store.py as needed so put(db, key, value) rejects empty-string keys with ValueError before writing. Direct callers of save must retain its current behavior. Preserve public signatures and avoid unrelated changes.

tasks.title: Deduplicate user validation
tasks.prompt: Refactor users.py to remove duplicate validation in create_user and update_user. Keep signatures, return values, and exact ValueError messages unchanged. Do not change the save functions or introduce a dependency.

tasks.title: Implement a detailed task-loading specification
tasks.prompt: Implement the requirements in REQUIREMENTS.md in loader.py. Keep the existing load_tasks(path) signature, use only the standard library, and make the focused changes needed to satisfy the document.

tasks.title: Implement a whole module from a specification
tasks.prompt: Implement the pipeline model module described in SPEC.md in model.py. The specification defines string enums, dataclasses, and a runtime-checkable protocol. Use only the Python standard library, and do not add a dependency on networkx. Every public type needs a docstring.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic risk scoring
tasks.prompt: Implement the deterministic risk scoring described in SPEC.md in risk.py. It scores how risky it is that a pipeline stage is affected by a change, using five weighted dimensions. Use only the Python standard library, and do not modify the inputs.

tasks.title: Implement pipeline change detection
tasks.prompt: Implement the change detection functions described in SPEC.md in changes.py. It compares two versions of a pipeline definition and reports added, removed, renamed, modified, and dependency changes. Use only the Python standard library, and do not modify any input.

tasks.title: Fix an order-dependent cache key
tasks.prompt: The cache key in cache.py depends on the order the filters were inserted, so two callers asking for the same filters in a different order miss the cache and re-run an expensive pipeline. Fix the key as described in REQUIREMENTS.md, keeping the public names build_key and get_cached.
